chunks: Jabir ibn Yazid and Mu'awiyah ibn Wahb narrated from Abu Abdullah عليه السلام that he said:

Whoever appoints a man as an agent to carry out a matter from among affairs, then the agency remains established permanently until he informs him of withdrawal from it, just as he informed him of entering into it.

key_terms.إِمْضَاءِ: carrying out or executing a matter
key_terms.الدُّخُولِ: the initiation or commencement of the agency
key_terms.الْخُرُوجِ: termination or withdrawal from the agency
key_terms.ثَابِتَةٌ: legally established and remaining in force
key_terms.وَكَّلَ: appointed someone as an agent or representative

ai.seo_question: Does an agency appointment remain valid until the agent is informed that it has been revoked?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling about agency: when a person appoints someone to act on his behalf, that authorization remains in force until the agent is informed that it has ended. It establishes continuity in wakalah and indicates that termination, like initiation, requires notification.
